content: {"sql": "SELECT name AS 厂站, capacity_m3d AS 设计处理规模_m3_d FROM plant WHERE name LIKE '%南郑中心%'", "explanation": "按厂站名称模糊匹配南郑中心污水处理厂，直接读取 plant 表中的设计处理规模字段。"}

{"sql": "SELECT name AS 厂站, kind AS 类型, process AS 工艺, capacity_m3d AS 设计规模_m3_d FROM plant WHERE kind = '集镇厂' ORDER BY capacity_m3d DESC LIMIT 1", "explanation": "从 plant 表中筛选集镇厂，按设计规模降序取第一条，即设计规模最大的集镇厂。"}
{"sql": "SELECT name AS 厂站, kind AS 类型, capacity_m3d AS 设计规模_m3_d FROM plant WHERE process = '氧化沟' ORDER BY id", "explanation": "从 plant 表中筛选处理工艺为氧化沟的厂站，列出名称、类型和设计规模。"}
{"sql": "SELECT count(*) AS 鼓风机总数, count(*) FILTER (WHERE d.status = '备用') AS 备用台数 FROM device d WHERE d.kind = '鼓风机'", "explanation": "从设备台账中筛选鼓风机，统计总数并用条件计数统计状态为备用的台数。"}
{"sql":"SELECT d.kind AS 设备类型, count(*) AS 设备数量, round(sum(d.rated_kw)::numeric, 1) AS 总额定功率_kW FROM device d GROUP BY d.kind ORDER BY 设备数量 DESC","explanation":"按设备类型分组统计设备台账中的设备数量并汇总额定功率。"}
{"sql": "SELECT sum(capacity_m3d) AS 设计规模合计_m3_d, count(*) AS 厂站数量 FROM plant", "explanation": "对 plant 表所有厂站的设计规模求和，并统计厂站数量。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, d.code AS 设备编码, d.kind AS 类型, d.model AS 型号, d.rated_kw AS 额定功率_kw, d.status AS 状态 FROM device d JOIN plant p ON p.id = d.plant_id WHERE p.name LIKE '%梁山%' ORDER BY d.code LIMIT 100", "explanation": "按厂站名称模糊匹配梁山镇污水处理站，关联设备台账列出设备编码、类型及状态等信息。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, d.code AS 设备编码, d.kind AS 类型, d.model AS 型号, round(d.rated_kw::numeric, 1) AS 额定功率_kW, d.status AS 状态 FROM device d JOIN plant p ON p.id = d.plant_id WHERE d.rated_kw IS NOT NULL ORDER BY d.rated_kw DESC, d.code LIMIT 10", "explanation": "按设备额定功率降序排列，关联厂站名称，取功率最大的前 10 台设备。"}

{"sql": "SELECT DISTINCT ON (p.id) p.name AS 厂站, r.ts AS 时间, round(r.do_aerobic_1::numeric, 2) AS 好氧区1号DO, round(r.do_aerobic_2::numeric, 2) AS 好氧区2号DO FROM plant_reading r JOIN plant p ON p.id = r.plant_id WHERE r.ts > now() - interval '30 minutes' ORDER BY p.id, r.ts DESC", "explanation": "取各厂站最近30分钟内最新一条实时数据，展示好氧区1号、2号溶解氧。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, r.ts AS 时间, round(r.inflow_m3h::numeric, 1) AS 进水流量_m3h FROM plant_reading r JOIN plant p ON p.id = r.plant_id WHERE p.name LIKE '%中心%' AND r.ts > now() - interval '30 minutes' ORDER BY r.ts DESC LIMIT 1", "explanation": "查中心厂最近30分钟内最新一条原始监测数据，取进水瞬时流量作为当前值。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, r.ts AS 时间, round(r.mlss::numeric, 0) AS 污泥浓度MLSS FROM plant_reading r JOIN plant p ON p.id = r.plant_id WHERE p.name LIKE '%协税%' AND r.ts > now() - interval '30 minutes' ORDER BY r.ts DESC LIMIT 1", "explanation": "按厂站名称模糊匹配协税镇，从实时表 plant_reading 取最近半小时内最新一条 MLSS 读数。"}

{"sql": "SELECT d.code AS 设备编码, r.ts AS 时间, round(r.current_a::numeric, 1) AS 电流_A, r.running AS 是否运行 FROM device_reading r JOIN device d ON d.id = r.device_id WHERE d.code = 'P01-BL-1' AND r.ts > now() - interval '30 minutes' ORDER BY r.ts DESC LIMIT 1", "explanation": "按设备编码 P01-BL-1 查最近 30 分钟内的最新一条监测记录，取当前电流值。"}

{"sql": "SELECT round(sum(h.inflow_m3h)::numeric) AS 处理水量_m3 FROM plant_reading_1h h WHERE h.hour >= date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '1 day' AND h.hour < date_trunc('day', now())", "explanation": "对昨天整日全区所有厂站的每小时处理水量求和得到昨日总处理水量。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, round(sum(h.inflow_m3h)::numeric) AS 处理水量_m3
FROM plant_reading_1h h JOIN plant p ON p.id = h.plant_id
WHERE h.hour >= date_trunc('week', now())
GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY 2 DESC", "explanation": "从本周一零点起按厂站汇总小时处理水量。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, round(sum(h.blower_kw)::numeric, 1) AS 鼓风机耗电量_kWh FROM plant_reading_1h h JOIN plant p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE p.code = 'P01' AND h.hour >= date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '1 day' AND h.hour < date_trunc('day', now()) GROUP BY p.name", "explanation": "按昨天自然日区间汇总中心厂小时表鼓风机功率（每小时即耗电量），得到全天总耗电量。"}

{"sql": "SELECT DISTINCT ON (p.id) p.name AS 厂站, r.ts AS 时间, round(r.tn_out::numeric, 2) AS 出水总氮_mgL FROM plant_reading r JOIN plant p ON p.id = r.plant_id WHERE r.ts > now() - interval '30 minutes' AND r.tn_out IS NOT NULL ORDER BY p.id, r.ts DESC", "explanation": "取各厂最近30分钟内最新一条实时数据的出水总氮，按厂站去重后列出最新值（可再按总氮排序即可看出哪个厂最高）。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, round(avg(h.nh3n_in)::numeric, 2) AS 平均进水氨氮_mgL FROM plant_reading_1h h JOIN plant p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE h.hour >= now() - interval '24 hours' GROUP BY p.id, p.name ORDER BY p.id", "explanation": "按厂站统计最近24小时小时表进水氨氮的均值，并保留两位小数。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, round(avg(h.cod_out)::numeric, 1) AS 出水COD均值, round(avg(h.nh3n_out)::numeric, 2) AS 出水氨氮均值, round(avg(h.tn_out)::numeric, 2) AS 出水总氮均值, round(avg(h.tp_out)::numeric, 3) AS 出水总磷均值, round(sum(h.inflow_m3h)::numeric, 0) AS 处理水量 FROM plant_reading_1h h JOIN plant p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE p.name LIKE '%中心%' AND h.hour >= date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '1 day' AND h.hour < date_trunc('day', now()) GROUP BY p.id, p.name", "explanation": "筛选名称含“中心”的厂站，取昨天自然日（0点至今日0点）小时均值表各出水指标的日均值，并附带处理水量。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, round(avg(h.cod_in)::numeric, 1) AS 进水COD平均值 FROM plant_reading_1h h JOIN plant p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE p.name LIKE '%中心%' AND h.hour >= date_trunc('day', now()) + interval '6 hours' AND h.hour < date_trunc('day', now()) + interval '12 hours' GROUP BY p.id, p.name", "explanation": "按“上午=06:00–12:00”筛选中心厂今日该时段的进水COD小时均值并取平均。"}

{"sql":"SELECT round(sum(h.carbon_dose_kgh)::numeric, 1) AS 碳源投加量_kg, round(sum(h.pac_dose_kgh)::numeric, 1) AS PAC投加量_kg FROM plant_reading_1h h WHERE h.hour >= date_trunc('week', now())","explanation":"汇总本周（自本周一零点起）全部厂站小时表的碳源与PAC投加量。"}

{"sql": "SELECT round(sum(h.blower_kw)::numeric, 1) AS 鼓风机总耗电量_kWh, round(sum(h.inflow_m3h)::numeric, 0) AS 处理水量_m3, round((sum(h.blower_kw) / nullif(sum(h.inflow_m3h), 0))::numeric, 4) AS 吨水曝气电耗_kWh FROM plant_reading_1h h WHERE h.hour >= date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '1 day' AND h.hour < date_trunc('day', now())", "explanation": "汇总昨天（前一自然日）全部厂站的小时鼓风机功率得总耗电量，处理水量取 inflow_m3h 之和，两者相除得吨水曝气电耗。"}

{"sql":"SELECT round((sum(h.inflow_m3h) / 6)::numeric, 2) AS 平均日处理水量_m3
FROM plant_reading_1h h
JOIN plant p ON p.id = h.plant_id
WHERE p.name LIKE '%梁山镇%'
  AND h.hour >= date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '6 days'
  AND h.hour < date_trunc('day', now())","explanation":"统计梁山镇污水处理站10月30日至11月4日6天的总处理水量，再除以6得到平均每天处理水量。"}

{"sql":"SELECT round(min(temp_c)::numeric, 1) AS 最低气温, round(max(temp_c)::numeric, 1) AS 最高气温 FROM weather WHERE ts >= date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '1 day' AND ts < date_trunc('day', now())","explanation":"统计昨天自然日内的气象气温最低值和最高值。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, round(avg(r.mlss)::numeric, 1) AS 平均污泥浓度_mgL, round(min(r.mlss)::numeric, 1) AS 最低值, round(max(r.mlss)::numeric, 1) AS 最高值 FROM plant_reading r JOIN plant p ON p.id = r.plant_id WHERE r.ts >= now() - interval '7 days' AND r.mlss IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.id, p.name ORDER BY p.id", "explanation": "小时均值表无 MLSS 字段，故用原始表 plant_reading 按厂站求过去 7 天 mlss 的均值、最小值和最大值。"}

{"sql": "SELECT h.hour AS 时间, round(h.tp_out::numeric, 3) AS 出水总磷均值
FROM plant_reading_1h h JOIN plant p ON p.id = h.plant_id
WHERE p.name LIKE '%协税%'
  AND h.hour >= timestamptz '2026-11-03 00:00:00+08'
  AND h.hour <  timestamptz '2026-11-04 00:00:00+08'
ORDER BY h.hour", "explanation": "按 11 月 3 日自然日范围筛选协税镇污水站的小时聚合数据，逐小时输出出水总磷均值。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '1 day' AS 统计日期, round(avg(h.air_flow_m3h)::numeric, 1) AS 平均曝气风量_m3h FROM plant_reading_1h h JOIN plant p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE p.name LIKE '%中心%' AND h.hour >= date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '1 day' AND h.hour < date_trunc('day', now()) GROUP BY p.name", "explanation": "筛选中心厂昨天自然日内的小时数据，对小时平均曝气风量 air_flow_m3h 求平均。"}

{"sql": "SELECT h.hour AS 时间, round(sum(h.inflow_m3h)::numeric, 1) AS 处理水量_m3
FROM plant_reading_1h h
WHERE h.hour >= date_trunc('day', now()) AND h.hour <= now()
GROUP BY h.hour
ORDER BY h.hour", "explanation": "按整点小时分组汇总全区所有厂站 plant_reading_1h 的小时处理水量，取今天 0 点到现在。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, round(avg(h.cod_out)::numeric, 1) AS 平均出水COD_mgL FROM plant_reading_1h h JOIN plant p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE h.hour >= now() - interval '7 days' GROUP BY p.id, p.name ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 1", "explanation": "按厂站统计最近7天出水COD的小时均值平均值，取最高者。"}

{"sql": "SELECT date_trunc('day', ts)::date AS 日期, round(avg(temp_c)::numeric, 1) AS 平均气温_摄氏度, count(*) AS 样本小时数 FROM weather WHERE ts >= timestamptz '2026-11-01 00:00:00+08' AND ts < timestamptz '2026-11-05 00:00:00+08' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1", "explanation": "从气象表按下自然日聚合 11 月 1 日至 4 日的平均气温。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, round(sum(h.inflow_m3h)::numeric) AS 处理水量_m3
FROM plant_reading_1h h JOIN plant p ON p.id = h.plant_id
WHERE h.hour >= date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '1 day'
  AND h.hour < date_trunc('day', now())
GROUP BY p.name
ORDER BY 2 DESC
LIMIT 3", "explanation": "按厂站汇总昨天（前一自然日）各小时处理水量，降序取前三名。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, round((sum(h.carbon_dose_kgh) / NULLIF(sum(h.inflow_m3h), 0))::numeric, 5) AS 吨水碳源投加量_kg每m3 FROM plant_reading_1h h JOIN plant p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE h.hour >= now() - interval '7 days' GROUP BY p.id, p.name ORDER BY 2 DESC", "explanation": "统计最近7天各厂碳源投加总量与处理水量之比，即吨水碳源投加量，并按从高到低排序。"}

{"sql":"SELECT (date_trunc('day', h.hour))::date AS 日期, round((sum(h.blower_kw) / nullif(sum(h.inflow_m3h), 0))::numeric, 4) AS 吨水曝气电耗_kWh FROM plant_reading_1h h JOIN plant p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE p.code = 'P01' AND h.hour >= date_trunc('week', now()) AND h.hour < date_trunc('week', now()) + interval '7 days' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1","explanation":"按本周每天汇总中心厂的鼓风机耗电量与处理水量，二者相除得到吨水曝气电耗。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, to_char(h.hour, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:00') AS 时间, round(h.cod_out::numeric, 1) AS 出水COD_mgL FROM plant_reading_1h h JOIN plant p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE h.hour >= now() - interval '7 days' AND h.cod_out IS NOT NULL ORDER BY h.cod_out DESC LIMIT 1", "explanation": "在过去7天的小时均值数据中按出水COD降序取第一条，定位最高小时的厂站、时间与数值。"}

{"sql": "SELECT date_trunc('day', h.hour)::date AS 日期, round(sum(h.inflow_m3h)::numeric) AS 处理水量_m3
FROM plant_reading_1h h
WHERE h.hour >= date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '7 days' AND h.hour < date_trunc('day', now())
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY sum(h.inflow_m3h) DESC
LIMIT 1", "explanation": "按天汇总全区近7天（不含今天）的处理水量，取水量最大的一天。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, round((sum(h.blower_kw) / sum(h.inflow_m3h))::numeric, 4) AS 吨水曝气电耗_kWh FROM plant_reading_1h h JOIN plant p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE h.hour >= date_trunc('week', now()) GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY 2 ASC LIMIT 2", "explanation": "统计本周各厂鼓风机耗电量与处理水量之比得到吨水电耗，按升序取最低的两个厂。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, count(*) AS 超标小时数, round(max(h.nh3n_out_max)::numeric, 2) AS 最高氨氮 FROM plant_reading_1h h JOIN plant p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE h.hour >= now() - interval '7 days' AND h.nh3n_out_max > 5 GROUP BY p.id, p.name ORDER BY p.id", "explanation": "统计最近7天各厂小时均值表中出水氨氮最大值超过一级A标准（5 mg/L）的小时数并按厂站汇总。"}

{"sql": "SELECT count(*) AS 总磷超标小时数, count(DISTINCT h.plant_id) AS 涉及厂站数, round(max(h.tp_out_max)::numeric, 3) AS 最高总磷 FROM plant_reading_1h h WHERE h.hour >= date_trunc('week', now()) AND h.hour < now() AND h.tp_out_max > 0.5", "explanation": "统计本周（周一起）各厂小时均值表中出水总磷最大值超过 0.5 mg/L 的小时记录数。"}

{"sql": "SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE h.nh3n_out_max > 5) AS 氨氮超标小时数, round(max(h.nh3n_out_max)::numeric, 2) AS 氨氮最高值_mgL FROM plant_reading_1h h JOIN plant p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE p.name LIKE '%黄官%' AND h.hour >= date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '1 day' AND h.hour < date_trunc('day', now())", "explanation": "筛选黄官镇昨天（11月4日）的小时数据，用小时出水氨氮最大值大于5判断超标，统计超标小时数并取当日最高值。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, round(avg(h.tn_out)::numeric, 2) AS 总氮平均浓度_mgL, round(max(h.tn_out)::numeric, 2) AS 总氮最大小时均值_mgL FROM plant_reading_1h h JOIN plant p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE p.name LIKE '%中心%' AND h.hour >= now() - interval '7 days' GROUP BY p.id, p.name", "explanation": "在小时均值表中筛选中心厂最近7天的出水总氮，计算平均值与最大小时均值。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE h.cod_out > 50 OR h.nh3n_out_max > 5 OR h.tn_out > 15
                          OR h.tp_out_max > 0.5 OR h.ss_out > 10) AS 出水不达标小时数
FROM plant p
LEFT JOIN plant_reading_1h h
       ON h.plant_id = p.id
      AND h.hour >= date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '1 day'
      AND h.hour < date_trunc('day', now())
GROUP BY p.id, p.name
ORDER BY p.id", "explanation": "以厂站表为主表左连接昨天的小时数据，按一级A标准统计各厂任一指标超标的小时数，无数据或全达标的厂显示 0。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, h.hour AS 超标时间, round(h.tp_out_max::numeric, 3) AS 出水总磷最高值_mg_L
FROM plant_reading_1h h JOIN plant p ON p.id = h.plant_id
WHERE p.name LIKE '%协税%'
  AND h.hour >= date_trunc('week', now())
  AND h.tp_out_max > 0.5
ORDER BY h.hour ASC
LIMIT 1", "explanation": "筛选协税镇污水站本周各小时中出水总磷最大值超过 0.5 mg/L 的记录，按时间升序取第一条即为本周首次超标时刻。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, d.code AS 设备编码, d.model AS 型号, round(d.rated_kw::numeric, 1) AS 额定功率_kW FROM device d JOIN plant p ON p.id = d.plant_id WHERE d.kind = '鼓风机' AND d.status = '备用' ORDER BY d.code", "explanation": "在设备台账中筛选类型为鼓风机且状态为备用的设备，关联厂站表显示所属厂站。"}

{"sql": "SELECT d.code AS 设备编码, p.name AS 厂站, round(max(r.vibration_mms)::numeric, 2) AS 最大振动_mm_s FROM device_reading r JOIN device d ON d.id = r.device_id JOIN plant p ON p.id = d.plant_id WHERE d.kind = '鼓风机' AND r.ts >= now() - interval '7 days' GROUP BY d.code, p.name ORDER BY max(r.vibration_mms) DESC LIMIT 1", "explanation": "统计过去7天各鼓风机的最大振动值，并按振动值降序取第一名。"}

{"sql": "SELECT d.code AS 设备编码, round(avg(r.temp_c)::numeric, 1) AS 平均温度_摄氏度, max(round(r.temp_c::numeric, 1)) AS 最高温度_摄氏度 FROM device_reading r JOIN device d ON d.id = r.device_id JOIN plant p ON p.id = d.plant_id WHERE p.code = 'P01' AND d.kind = '鼓风机' AND r.running AND r.ts >= now() - interval '24 hours' GROUP BY d.code ORDER BY d.code", "explanation": "按设备编码统计中心厂（P01）24小时内处于运行状态的鼓风机平均与最高轴承温度。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, d.code AS 设备编码, count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT r.running) AS 停机分钟数 FROM device_reading r JOIN device d ON d.id = r.device_id JOIN plant p ON p.id = d.plant_id WHERE p.name LIKE '%黄官%' AND d.code = 'P06-BL-1' AND r.ts >= date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '1 day' AND r.ts < date_trunc('day', now()) GROUP BY p.name, d.code", "explanation": "筛选黄官镇1号鼓风机在11月4日全天的分钟级设备数据，统计 running=false 的记录数作为停机分钟数。"}

{"sql":"SELECT d.code AS 设备编码, round(avg(r.current_a)::numeric, 1) AS 平均电流_A FROM device_reading r JOIN device d ON d.id = r.device_id JOIN plant p ON p.id = d.plant_id WHERE p.name LIKE '%中心%' AND d.kind = '提升泵' AND r.running AND r.ts >= date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '1 day' AND r.ts < date_trunc('day', now()) GROUP BY d.code ORDER BY d.code","explanation":"筛选中心厂提升泵，统计昨天运行状态下的平均电流并按设备编码分组。"}

{"sql": "SELECT round(max(rain_mm_h)::numeric, 2) AS 最大降雨强度_mm_h, to_char(date_trunc('day', now()), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS 查询日期 FROM weather WHERE ts >= timestamp '2026-10-31 00:00:00+08' AND ts < timestamp '2026-11-01 00:00:00+08'", "explanation": "筛选2026年10月31日全天的气象数据，取降雨强度的最大值。"}

{"sql": "SELECT r.ts AS 首次超标时间, round(r.vibration_mms::numeric, 2) AS 振动_mm_s FROM device_reading r JOIN device d ON d.id = r.device_id WHERE d.code = 'P06-BL-1' AND r.ts >= date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '1 day' AND r.ts < date_trunc('day', now()) AND r.vibration_mms > 7.1 ORDER BY r.ts ASC LIMIT 1", "explanation": "在11月4日范围内查询黄官镇1号鼓风机（P06-BL-1）振动值首次超过7.1 mm/s的记录，按时间升序取第一条。"}

{"sql": "SELECT min(ts) AS 开始时间, max(ts) + interval '1 hour' AS 结束时间, count(*) AS 降雨小时数, round(sum(rain_mm_h)::numeric, 1) AS 降雨量_mm FROM weather WHERE ts >= timestamp with time zone '2026-10-31 00:00:00+08' AND ts < timestamp with time zone '2026-11-01 00:00:00+08' AND rain_mm_h > 0", "explanation": "筛选2026年10月31日降雨强度大于0的记录，取最早时间为降雨开始、最后降雨小时结束为降雨结束，并汇总降雨小时数和降雨量。"}

{"sql":"SELECT p.name AS 厂站, d.code AS 设备编码, count(*) FILTER (WHERE dr.running) AS 运行分钟数 FROM device d JOIN plant p ON p.id = d.plant_id LEFT JOIN device_reading dr ON dr.device_id = d.id AND dr.ts >= date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '1 day' AND dr.ts < date_trunc('day', now()) WHERE d.kind = '污泥泵' GROUP BY p.id, p.name, d.id, d.code ORDER BY p.id, d.code","explanation":"关联设备台账筛选污泥泵，按昨天自然日统计各厂每台污泥泵 running=true 的分钟数。"}

{"sql": "WITH t AS (SELECT r.ts, r.do_aerobic_1, r.do_aerobic_2 FROM plant_reading r JOIN plant p ON p.id = r.plant_id WHERE p.name LIKE '%黄官%' AND r.ts >= timestamptz '2026-11-04 15:00:00+08' AND r.ts < timestamptz '2026-11-04 18:00:00+08') SELECT round(min(do_aerobic_1)::numeric, 2) AS 好氧区1号DO最低值, round(min(do_aerobic_2)::numeric, 2) AS 好氧区2号DO最低值, (SELECT to_char(ts, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') FROM t ORDER BY do_aerobic_1 ASC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1) AS 最低值出现时间, count(*) AS 采样点数 FROM t", "explanation": "取黄官镇污水厂11月4日15:00-18:00的原始分钟级数据，统计好氧区溶解氧最低值及出现时刻"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, round(sum(CASE WHEN h.hour >= timestamptz '2026-10-31 00:00:00+08' AND h.hour < timestamptz '2026-11-01 00:00:00+08' THEN h.inflow_m3h ELSE 0 END)::numeric) AS 暴雨当天处理水量_m3, round(sum(CASE WHEN h.hour >= timestamptz '2026-10-30 00:00:00+08' AND h.hour < timestamptz '2026-10-31 00:00:00+08' THEN h.inflow_m3h ELSE 0 END)::numeric) AS 前一天处理水量_m3, round((sum(CASE WHEN h.hour >= timestamptz '2026-10-31 00:00:00+08' AND h.hour < timestamptz '2026-11-01 00:00:00+08' THEN h.inflow_m3h ELSE 0 END) - sum(CASE WHEN h.hour >= timestamptz '2026-10-30 00:00:00+08' AND h.hour < timestamptz '2026-10-31 00:00:00+08' THEN h.inflow_m3h ELSE 0 END))::numeric) AS 增加量_m3 FROM plant_reading_1h h JOIN plant p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE p.name LIKE '%梁山镇%' AND h.hour >= timestamptz '2026-10-30 00:00:00+08' AND h.hour < timestamptz '2026-11-01 00:00:00+08' GROUP BY p.name", "explanation": "按梁山镇污水处理站统计2026-10-31与10-30两个自然日的处理水量并求差值。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, round(max(h.tp_out_max)::numeric, 3) AS 出水总磷最高值 FROM plant_reading_1h h JOIN plant p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE p.name LIKE '%协税%' AND h.hour >= '2026-11-03 00:00:00+08' AND h.hour < '2026-11-04 00:00:00+08' GROUP BY p.id, p.name", "explanation": "按日期范围筛选协税镇污水站当天的小时数据，取 tp_out_max 的最大值作为当日出水总磷峰值。"}

{"sql": "WITH t AS (SELECT p.kind, sum(h.inflow_m3h) AS v FROM plant_reading_1h h JOIN plant p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE h.hour >= now() - interval '7 days' GROUP BY p.kind) SELECT round(sum(v) FILTER (WHERE kind = '中心厂')::numeric, 0) AS 中心厂处理水量_m3, round(sum(v)::numeric, 0) AS 全区处理水量_m3, round((sum(v) FILTER (WHERE kind = '中心厂') / sum(v) * 100)::numeric, 2) AS 占比_百分比 FROM t", "explanation": "统计最近7天各厂站小时处理水量，按厂站类型汇总，计算中心厂水量占全区总水量的百分比。"}

{"sql":"WITH plant_avg AS (
  SELECT p.id, p.name, avg(h.cod_in) AS avg_cod
  FROM plant_reading_1h h
  JOIN plant p ON p.id = h.plant_id
  WHERE h.hour >= now() - interval '7 days'
  GROUP BY p.id, p.name
), overall AS (
  SELECT avg(h.cod_in) AS avg_all
  FROM plant_reading_1h h
  WHERE h.hour >= now() - interval '7 days'
)
SELECT pa.name AS 厂站,
       round(pa.avg_cod::numeric, 1) AS 平均进水COD,
       round(o.avg_all::numeric, 1) AS 全区平均进水COD
FROM plant_avg pa
CROSS JOIN overall o
WHERE pa.avg_cod > o.avg_all
ORDER BY pa.avg_cod DESC","explanation":"统计过去7天各厂站平均进水COD，并与全区整体平均进水COD比较，筛选出高于全区平均水平的厂站。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, round((1 - avg(h.tn_out) / avg(h.tn_in))::numeric * 100, 1) AS 总氮去除率_百分比 FROM plant_reading_1h h JOIN plant p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE h.hour >= now() - interval '7 days' GROUP BY p.id, p.name ORDER BY p.id", "explanation": "查询过去7天各厂小时均值的进水/出水总氮，用 1-出水TN均值/进水TN均值 计算总氮去除率百分比。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, p.capacity_m3d AS 设计规模_m3_d, round(sum(h.inflow_m3h)::numeric, 0) AS 昨日处理水量_m3, round((sum(h.inflow_m3h) / p.capacity_m3d * 100)::numeric, 1) AS 负荷率_百分比 FROM plant_reading_1h h JOIN plant p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE h.hour >= date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '1 day' AND h.hour < date_trunc('day', now()) GROUP BY p.id, p.name, p.capacity_m3d ORDER BY p.id", "explanation": "汇总各厂昨日 24 小时处理水量（1h 表 inflow_m3h 之和），除以设计规模得到负荷率百分比。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.process AS 处理工艺, round(sum(h.inflow_m3h)::numeric) AS 处理水量_m3, count(DISTINCT p.id) AS 厂站数 FROM plant_reading_1h h JOIN plant p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE h.hour >= date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '1 day' AND h.hour < date_trunc('day', now()) GROUP BY p.process ORDER BY p.process", "explanation": "按处理工艺分组，统计昨天（前一自然日）各小时进水流量之和，得到各工艺的累计处理水量。"}

{"sql":"WITH daily AS (
  SELECT date_trunc('day', h.hour)::date AS day,
         sum(h.inflow_m3h) AS water_m3
  FROM plant_reading_1h h
  WHERE h.hour >= date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '2 days'
    AND h.hour < date_trunc('day', now())
  GROUP BY 1
), vals AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(sum(CASE WHEN day = (date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '1 day')::date THEN water_m3 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS yesterday_m3,
    COALESCE(sum(CASE WHEN day = (date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '2 days')::date THEN water_m3 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS prev_m3
  FROM daily
)
SELECT round(yesterday_m3::numeric, 1) AS 昨天处理水量_m3,
       round(prev_m3::numeric, 1) AS 前天处理水量_m3,
       round((yesterday_m3 - prev_m3)::numeric, 1) AS 增加量_m3
FROM vals;","explanation":"分别汇总昨天和前天的全区小时处理水量，再计算昨天相对前天的增加量。"}

{"sql":"WITH rain_day AS (
  SELECT date_trunc('day', w.ts)::date AS day,
         max(w.rain_mm_h) AS max_rain_mm_h
  FROM weather w
  WHERE w.ts >= now() - interval '7 days'
  GROUP BY 1
  ORDER BY max_rain_mm_h DESC
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT r.day AS 日期,
       round(r.max_rain_mm_h::numeric, 2) AS 最大降雨强度_mm_h,
       round(coalesce(sum(h.inflow_m3h), 0)::numeric, 0) AS 全区处理水量_m3
FROM rain_day r
LEFT JOIN plant_reading_1h h
  ON h.hour >= (r.day::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai')
 AND h.hour < ((r.day + 1)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai')
GROUP BY r.day, r.max_rain_mm_h;","explanation":"先找出过去7天中小时最大降雨强度最高的自然日，再汇总该日全区所有厂站的处理水量。"}
